messages:
zoe: Quick ping  Action Item #15 from the postmortem (telemetry redaction for Private) is overdue. Owner: @max. Can we get status and an ETA? :wave:

max: Sorry, got pulled into an outage yesterday. Blocker was ambiguity from legal about allowed fields. I have a proposed schema in the PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/4882 (WIP). Planning to get legal sign-off today.

claire: We have a compliance audit next Tue. If legal is the blocker, I can escalate to get a 24h turnaround. @max can you paste the minimal fieldset here so I can include it in the escalation note?

max: Minimal fields: request_id, model_name, prompt_hash (truncated), timestamp. No raw prompt, no user PII. Added masking rules in the PR description.

ops-bot: Reminder: Action Item #15 assigned to max is overdue (due 1808716068). Update the tracker: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-210/actions.

claire: I'm escalating to legal now, will request expedited review. @max please add a unit test demonstrating masked prompt_hash to speed approval.

max: Added test `tests/test_masking.py` to the branch. Also added a short rationale for telemetry minimization.

[30m later]

ops-bot: Legal review complete: approved with one minor comment on retention period.

max: Pushed fix for retention comment and updated PR. Running CI. ETA for merge: 2h.

claire: Great. Once merged, please update the incident tracker and leave a short note in the postmortem about "telemetry fieldset and legal turnaround" so we can surface recurring delays.

max: CI passed, PR merged and canary passed in private-staging. Updated tracker: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-210/actions#15.

zoe: Verified tracker and postmortem updated. Closing Action Item #15. :white_check_mark:

max: Will open a low-priority follow-up to parametrize retention TTLs. Thanks everyone.

zoe: Closing thread.
